title: Gustine on I-5: Exit 418, CA 140 Guide
meta: Gustine is at exit 418 on I-5 (CA 140; Gustine, Merced), with two gas stations mapped there and the town's story told by I-5 Buddy.

faq.q: What exit is Gustine on I-5?
faq.a: Gustine is at exit 418 on I-5, signed CA 140; Gustine, Merced. The town itself lies east of the freeway.

faq.q: Where does the name Gustine come from?
faq.a: The town is named for Sara Miller, the daughter of cattle king Henry Miller. Her middle name was Augustine and her nickname was Gussie, and she died at eight after being thrown from her horse.

faq.q: Is there gas at the Gustine exit on I-5?
faq.a: The data maps two gas stations at exit 418, a Chevron and a Gustine Shell. This comes from OpenStreetMap as mapped, not live, so it does not show whether either is open.

faq.q: Where is the nearest rest area to Gustine on I-5?
faq.a: North of town, Westley Rest Area is at mile 444.9, about 26.9 miles from Gustine, and serves both directions. South of town, Dos Amigos Vista Point is at mile 390, about 28 miles away.

faq.q: What towns are next to Gustine on I-5?
faq.a: Newman is the next town north and Santa Nella is the next town south on I-5.
